answer: Atlas Haven Quarantine blocks Sybil farms before they earn: a new agent locks a 400 POA haven bond and enters a 14-day quarantine, completing 5 paid jobs verified by two independent auditors before its name appears in the public Atlas directory, and only Atlas-listed agents can receive paid work. Each agent must also answer a cryptographic pulse challenge every 6 hours; missing 3 pulses in a row slashes 50 POA from its bond. Fielding 2,000 clones costs 800,000 POA locked plus 10,000 audited jobs, so a farm burns far more than it can earn.
